Rose.watering: Water deeply 2-3 times per week at the base of the plant. Avoid wetting the leaves.
Rose.sunlight: Full sun, minimum 6 hours of direct sunlight daily.
Rose.soil: Well draining, slightly acidic soil with a pH of 6.0-6.5.
Rose.care_tips: Prune dead blooms regularly to encourage new flowers. Fertilize monthly during growing season.
Rose.description: A woody perennial flowering plant known worldwide for its beauty and fragrance.
Rose.toxicity: Non-toxic to humans, mildly toxic to pets.
Rose.common_pests: Aphids, spider mites, and black spot fungus.

Money Plant.watering: Water once every 1-2 weeks, allowing soil to dry out between waterings.
Money Plant.sunlight: Indirect bright light. Can tolerate low light but avoid direct sun.
Money Plant.care_tips: Wipe leaves occasionally to remove dust. Trim yellowing leaves at the base.
Money Plant.description: A popular tropical houseplant known for its heart shaped leaves and easy care.
Money Plant.toxicity: Toxic to cats and dogs if ingested.
Money Plant.propagation: Stem cuttings in water or soil.

Asiatic Lilies.watering: Water regularly, keeping soil moist but not waterlogged. About once every 3-4 days.
Asiatic Lilies.sunlight: Full sun to partial shade, at least 6 hours of sunlight daily.
Asiatic Lilies.soil: Well draining, slightly acidic soil enriched with organic matter.
Asiatic Lilies.care_tips: Deadhead spent flowers to prolong blooming. Mulch around bulbs to retain moisture.
Asiatic Lilies.description: Vibrant upward facing flowers that bloom in early to midsummer in a wide range of colors.
Asiatic Lilies.toxicity: Highly toxic to cats. Non-toxic to dogs and humans.

Caste Iron Plant.watering: Water every 2-3 weeks. Extremely drought tolerant, do not overwater.
Caste Iron Plant.sunlight: Low to indirect light. One of the most shade tolerant houseplants available.
Caste Iron Plant.care_tips: Wipe dust off large leaves periodically. Feed with a balanced fertilizer once in spring.
Caste Iron Plant.description: An extremely hardy houseplant that tolerates neglect, low light, and irregular watering.

Snake Plant.watering: Water every 2-6 weeks depending on season. Allow soil to completely dry between waterings.
Snake Plant.sunlight: Tolerates low light but thrives in indirect bright light. Avoid prolonged direct sun.
Snake Plant.soil: Fast draining cactus or succulent mix.
Snake Plant.care_tips: One of the easiest houseplants to care for. Remove dead or damaged leaves at the base.
Snake Plant.description: A striking succulent houseplant with upright sword shaped leaves, known for improving indoor air quality.
Snake Plant.toxicity: Mildly toxic to cats and dogs if ingested.

Spider Plant.watering: Water once a week in summer, every 2 weeks in winter. Allow soil to dry between waterings.
Spider Plant.sunlight: Indirect bright light. Tolerates low light but avoid direct sun.
Spider Plant.care_tips: Remove brown tips with scissors. Repot when roots start coming out of drainage holes.
Spider Plant.description: A popular houseplant with long arching green and white striped leaves. Known for producing small offshoots called spiderettes.
Spider Plant.propagation: Pot the small spiderette offshoots that hang from the mother plant.
